description: Inspect directory listings, checksum output and load errors for signs of checkpoint corruption. Supplied metadata does not verify full shard coverage, compatible optimizer state or successful workload recovery. Validate actual loading and intended progress before resuming.

directoryListing.description: Output of `ls -la` (or `ls -la --time-style=full-iso`) on the checkpoint directory.

failureType.description: The diagnosed failure type, if you have one, it sharpens the verdict.

loadErrors.description: Any error output from trying to load a checkpoint.

sha256Output.description: Output of `sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256`, if you keep a manifest.

name: validate_checkpoint
title: Inspect supplied checkpoint integrity evidence
